zoe (CSE): Quick flag: Meridian onboarding summarize route p95 ~2.4s, they're on renewal watch and called this out in last sync.

zoe (CSE): They asked for latency wins without much quality loss.
raj (AE): I can book a 20m sync and ask for 8 example docs and their sign-off metric.
mike (SRE): Ops quick wins: enable route prefix KV cache (TTL 12h) and add an ingress rule to throttle large concurrent jobs.
hana (ML Eng): Experiment plan: 1) Canary int8 build redwood-open-xl-v1-int8 at 10% scoped to meridian. 2) Route docs >2600 tokens to redwood-compact-xl-qa with a short prompt shim. 3) 20-sample eval for ROUGE/QA fidelity.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: redwood-open-xl-v1-int8 -> 10% via policy "meridian-int8-pilot".
mike (SRE): I'll stage routing rule: if input_tokens>2600 && customer=="meridian" -> redwood-compact-xl-qa (canary 10%). Also adding dashboard tiles for p95, cost, and custom ROUGE metric.
hana (ML Eng): Eval preview: float p95 2400ms ROUGE-L 0.74; int8 p95 1250ms ROUGE-L 0.737; compact p95 920ms ROUGE-L 0.705. Small quality delta, big latency win.
zoe (CSE): Customer note draft: "short pilot to reduce tail latency via int8 canary + selective routing of very long docs to compact model. We'll monitor quality closely and rollback immediately if you see regressions." OK?
raj (AE): Good. I'll share expected cost delta and propose reserved capacity incentive if pilot acceptable.
hana (ML Eng): Rollback steps: set canary 0%, remove routing rule; alert if ROUGE-L delta >1.0% -> notify @hana @zoe.
mike (SRE): Ops checklist: [x] KV cache enabled [x] routing rule staged [x] canary queued [ ] dashboard live (ETA EOD).
zoe (CSE): Owners: Hana=evals, Mike=ops/dashboard, Raj=customer comms, Zoe=enablement notes. Updating ticket CS-11337. Ping here with any critical alerts. :thumbsup:
